ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Off`, and `light` is false. The transition out of `Off` has no condition, but it is not checked in the tick `Off` was entered.
The transition out of `Off` has no condition, so it fires: `light` is true and the chart is in `On`.
And back: `light` is false and the chart is in `Off`.
`On` again. The chart has no inputs at all, yet every tick it does something.
`Off` again. How long is one blink? One tick. How long is a tick? The chart cannot say.
